description: This file defines the SlidingTabStrip class, a custom Android view extending LinearLayout, used for rendering tab indicators with customizable colors, underlines, and dividers in a tab layout component.

classes.name: SlidingTabStrip
classes.description: A custom view for rendering the visual indicators and separators for a tab layout in an Android application.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.TabColorizer
classes.description: Interface to provide custom colors for tab indicator and divider.

classes.name: SlidingTabLayout.SimpleTabColorizer
classes.description: Default implementation of TabColorizer used internally for default colors.

methods.name: setCustomTabColorizer
methods.description: Sets a custom TabColorizer for customizing tab indicator and divider colors.

methods.name: setSelectedIndicatorColors
methods.description: Sets the colors used for the indicator beneath the selected tab.

methods.name: setDividerColors
methods.description: Defines the colors for dividers between tabs.

methods.name: onViewPagerPageChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected tab position and offset, typically called during page scrolling.
